advisory_messages.message_text: About 15 cassava plants on the lower edge of my Bong County plot started showing yellow-green patches on new top leaves after heavy rains. What steps should I take?
Heavy rain flooded our lowland rice plot to knee depth overnight. Will draining down to 4 cm today hurt newly transplanted rice?

Draining excess floodwater gradually down to 3–4 cm will protect your newly transplanted seedlings from submergence stress. Open the spillway slowly so soil around young roots is not washed away, and check that bunds have no weak cracks.

local_language_recordings.question_text: Why are my cassava leaves turning yellow after heavy rain?
local_language_recordings.answer_text: Check if rainwater is standing around the cassava mound. Open a small drainage trench so roots do not rot, and inspect under young leaves for small whiteflies.

local_language_recordings.question_text: How can I make poor sandy soil better without buying costly fertilizer?
local_language_recordings.answer_text: Mix dry grass, kitchen peelings, and animal droppings into a shaded compost pile, turn it every two weeks, and add dark compost to planting beds before rain.

local_language_recordings.question_text: How do I keep young chicks warm and healthy during rainy nights?
local_language_recordings.answer_text: Keep the poultry coop dry, block cold wind with woven mats or tarpaulin, use dry wood shavings on the floor, and wash water drinkers every morning.

local_language_recordings.question_text: How do I stop my harvested rice and corn from molding in storage?
local_language_recordings.answer_text: Dry grains on raised mats or clean tarpaulins—never bare wet soil. Store only when kernels snap cleanly under your tooth, in sealed bags off the floor.

local_language_recordings.question_text: Why do pond fish come to the surface gasping early in the morning?
local_language_recordings.answer_text: Early-morning gasping often signals low oxygen in pond water. Avoid overfeeding, remove uneaten feed, and let fresh clean water trickle gently into the pond.

local_language_recordings.question_text: What should I do when caterpillars eat inside my young corn?
local_language_recordings.answer_text: Inspect the central funnel of young maize plants early morning. Hand-pick small egg clusters on small plots and consult an agricultural officer before any spray.

demo_expert_requests.title: Chicks huddling and sneezing after cool night rain
demo_expert_requests.description: Twelve 3-week-old chicks in my backyard coop started huddling together and breathing noisily after heavy rain last night.
demo_expert_requests.expert_reply: Check immediately for wet bedding or drafts entering the coop. Replace damp litter with dry wood shavings, keep clean warm water available, separate any weak chicks, and request an in-person veterinary officer check if breathing noise worsens.
